institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, District of Utah

remedy.notes: Memorandum decision and order of Judge Ted Stewart, 9 September 2026, following a show-cause order of 30 July 2026 and a hearing on 2 September 2026. The penalties are several and unequal, $2,000 and $1,000 against two named attorneys rather than a single $3,000 obligation, and the CLE requirement binds only the drafting attorney; the signing attorney told the court he had already enrolled in a course himself. This is the corpus’s first record naming four distinct AI tools in one matter, and the only one to date in which a citation-checking product appears alongside general-purpose models without the order distinguishing their roles.
